verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sierra has 'hand-off rules' you can experiment with, and Live Assist captures customer context for reps during their own work. Neither documents what a human receives when the AI agent escalates: the full transcript, a summary, or collected details. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for the escalation-handoff story.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves
